name: Purple-Team-Automation: AD Credential Access Chain, Detection Coverage
description: Results of the Caldera 'AD Credential Access Chain' operation (22 Sep 2026), revised 25 Nov 2026. Green means a deployed rule raised an alert. Yellow means the attack's events reached Elastic but no rule alerted. Red means a gap: no events, or a rule that cannot match the attack. No technique is green yet.

techniques.comment: Password Spraying via Kerbrute. GAP. Events reached Elastic as 4771 (28 hits), but no rule was deployed, and the Sigma rule counts 4625, which Kerbrute never produces.

Kerberoasting via GetUserSPNs.py. Events reached Elastic as 4769 with RC4 0x17 (2 hits). No alerting rule was deployed. The tuned Sigma rule also allow-lists svc_sql, the account this operation roasts.
AS-REP Roasting via GetNPUsers.py. Events reached Elastic as 4768 with PreAuthType 0 for j.jenkins (8 hits). No alerting rule was deployed.
DCSync via secretsdump.py. Events reached Elastic as 4662 (8 hits). The DCSync rule was deployed and ran 27 times on 22 Sep, but raised 0 alerts. Cause not yet found.

LLMNR/NBT-NS Poisoning via Responder (manual, not run through Caldera, Stockpile's only option, Inveigh, is Windows-only). KNOWN GAP: zero Sysmon Event 3/22 visibility. Negative control carried over from elk-siem-lab findings.
